summary: The measured core of this subject is sound and I could not break it: the subject, HEAD, COORD, file 02 and file 08 pins match live bytes; all 134 recordedInputs recompute clean; all fourteen predecessor objects and all twenty-seven verdict files on disk are pinned at matching digests with verdicts read from the files; the twelve joins are the versions the highest non-CONTESTED COORD recording names under both heading spellings, and each recording entry carries the join's digest and both verdict digests; every leftoverDesign assertion in the fourteen classes matches the live join bytes; the 46-site refresh is exactly the diff against frozen v10 and reverses to canonical-JSON equality; the doesNot union is the exact ordered union of the twelve live arrays; the pin-shape sentence holds at every object; only v14 is called the immediate predecessor; every reviewer identifier on disk is disposed exactly once; DR-117 is stated SATISFIED as of D-363 with gates 4 and 5 performed there, and D-364 clauses 7 and 9 are cited as adopted. What defeats it is again prose the generator did not regenerate. Two doesNot entries regressed to preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's own self-token, so the file now says recording v10 'remains a later D-000 act' although D-295 recorded it. The census sentence appended to those entries says every unrecorded version was 'rejected at Stage A by both reviewers', which is false for v3, v4 and v6 against the verdict files the same file pins, and contradicts its own earlierStanding. PPBSV13-B1's disposition still carries the 'six' both v14 reviewers flagged and now also a 'thirteen' against fourteen objects, while two v14 dispositions say those counts were fixed and that no disposition states a count. authorityClaim's recital still starts at v5 while CLAUDE-PPBS-V14-SF2's disposition says it now starts at the earliest frozen version. Below those: CELL-2 still ends 'Not SATISFIED' in the field that pins the SATISFIED row; the two does-not-unwrite ranges disagree with each other and stop short of D-365; the carried-standing NOTE still misdescribes CLAUDE-PPBS-V2-ADV-1 as carried from v10; and CLAUDE-PPBS-V14-ADV-1's disposition describes a different repair.

gradeRuling.question: D-005 form: is preview-product-boundary-successor.v15, as bytes, acceptable at application grade as DR-117's preview-scoped design candidate?
gradeRuling.reservationSweep: I swept these bytes for anything that would have to travel as an express reservation on an application-grade acceptance. The scope limits the file states - CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, DO-NOT-SEAL, performs no gate, does not re-perform the D-316 opening, does not disturb the D-363 recording, does not edit file 08 or COORD - are accurate and are the right reservations for a citation-refresh successor issued after the row went SATISFIED; they are not what defeats the grade. What defeats it are four false statements about the file's own contents and record: that recording preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 is a later act; that v3, v4 and v6 were rejected by both reviewers; that fourteen objects are thirteen and eight are six, under two dispositions that say the counts were fixed; and that the authority recital begins at the earliest frozen version, under a disposition that says so. Beyond those, and the four SHOULD-FIX items, the sweep is clean: no unpinned frozen version, no undisposed or duplicated identifier, no pin-shape clause false at any object, no class assertion the named join does not carry, no stale join currency, no digest that does not match live bytes, no D-364 clause overstated, no D-363 or D-316 re-performance, no deixis of the rejected form, no byte-identity claim, no broad no-other-change claim, and no SATISFIED, gate-4, gate-5, required-now, G13 or implementation-authorization overreach.
reasons: The recording act that would rest on these bytes reads doesNot to learn what recording does; doesNot[26] tells it the current recording has not happened. That is the one sentence in the file whose audience is exactly the act being asked to trust it.

Three of the four blockers are the species this lineage has been rejected for four times running: a claim about the predecessor record that the bytes do not satisfy, this time with the census present and correct underneath it, so the prose is wrong where the data is right.

Five dispositions in the array a later cycle would read instead of re-walking the directory assert repairs that were not made. The generated census ended that failure inside basedOn, predecessorStanding, recordedInputs and doesNot's enumeration; it did not reach authorityClaim or the disposition texts, and the dispositions say it did.

The refresh the subject exists to perform is done and proved: 46 sites, exact per-lineage counts, class equality under reversal, exact union, twelve current joins at their COORD-named versions with digests in their own entries. The next dispatch should change nothing in those fields.

verdictStatement: REJECT. Four MUST-FIX and four SHOULD-FIX stand. The measured core holds everywhere I could test it: pins, digests, verdicts, join currency under both heading spellings, the fourteen classes against live join bytes, the 46-site refresh, class equality under reversal, the exact union, the pin-shape sentence, the single immediate predecessor, and the seventy-four-identifier closure. The generated prose around that core is where it fails: two doesNot entries regressed to preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's self-token and now say the current recording is a later act; the census sentence appended to them invents a second REJECT for v3, v4 and v6; PPBSV13-B1's disposition keeps 'thirteen' and 'six' against fourteen and eight while two dispositions say the counts were fixed; authorityClaim's recital still starts at v5 under a disposition that says it starts at v1. CELL-2's unscoped 'Not SATISFIED', the D-362/D-364 range disagreement short of D-365, the carried-standing NOTE's misdescription of CLAUDE-PPBS-V2-ADV-1, and CLAUDE-PPBS-V14-ADV-1's unresponsive disposition follow at SHOULD-FIX.
